smokeTestNotes: Docs and pricing pages checked. No account, payment, or hands-on run.
name: ChatGPT
shortDescription: General-purpose chat assistant from OpenAI, with a free plan and paid Go and Plus plans.
longDescription: ChatGPT is OpenAI's general chat assistant. The pricing page lists Free, Go, Plus, and Pro. OpenAI's Go announcement lists Go at $8 per month in the US, and the Plus help article lists Plus at $20 per month. We did not subscribe. It is not a specialist for one job.
pricingNotes: OpenAI lists Go at $8 per month in the US and Plus at $20 per month. A free plan is on the pricing page.
bestFor: Researching, comparing, and drafting in a general chat
notIdealFor: A job that needs parcel records, a brokerage link, or a video timeline
strength: OpenAI lists a free ChatGPT plan, with Go at $8 per month and Plus at $20 per month.
weakness: It is a general chat assistant, not a portfolio, parcel, or video editor built for one job.
